strings.name: Abderrahmane Sissako
strings.summary: Born in Mauritania and raised in Mali, Sissako studied cinema in Moscow. His poetic narratives examine migration, inequality and African society. Bamako stages a trial of international economic institutions; Timbuktu depicts life under extremism. Black Tea explores African-Chinese encounters. He continued discussing cinema internationally in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Through Bamako, Timbuktu and other films, examines African social and political realities and advances international exchange in African cinema.
